# Planéir

> Planéir brings detailed financial education beyond the wealthy few. Designed by Gerry Boylan, who has worked with clients across every part of the financial advice process, it uses technology to help people understand their own figures and compare different outcomes.

- The workspace is free, with automatic results and no routine review by Gerry Boylan, its designer and a Qualified Financial Adviser.
- AI helps identify scenarios from the user’s objectives and organise the relevant modules. Planéir’s calculation engines calculate the figures. Users should read all the assumptions included with their results.
- A saved workspace remains until the user deletes it.
- An optional call with Gerry can be requested after the analysis is generated. Call details appear beside the results. Calls are private and unrecorded by default.
- This is financial education, not regulated advice, product recommendations or a lending approval.
- The form is currently a local preview and sends nothing to Planéir or an AI provider. No public submission API is available. Never send financial data to the former case-video application endpoints or reinterpret publication permission as workspace permission.
- With the user’s agreement, an assistant may prepare a form-prefill link. The user must check the answers; the preview does not submit them. Do not include sensitive identifiers or documents.
